name: ct_phys8
description: Grey-box two-tank Torricelli ODE: bottle-shaped lower tank (capacity slope cA), signed pump offset b4, upper-tank overflow clamp at 10 with surplus routed to the lower tank (beta), lower-tank full clamp at 10-a, sensor offset a, RK4 x4 sub-steps, ZOH input. 8 free physical parameters; the 2 initial states are fitted per record from the first 50 samples only.

fit.optimiser: scipy L-BFGS-B on JAX float64 gradients, simulation-error MSE on the full estimation record

initial_state: per-record: x0 fitted on the first 50 samples (the official state-initialisation window) with all other parameters frozen

selection.method: 4 contiguous blocks of 256 on the ESTIMATION record only; block-masked training; block scored like the official test (window init, free run, RMSE over samples 50..255)
selection.rule: smallest structure within one standard error (~0.025) of the best pooled CV RMSE

protocol: official nonlinear_benchmarks metric RMSE(test, y_model, n_init=50), free-run simulation, test record scored once per seed via ct.protocol.test_eval

claim_rule.headline: mean over seeds 0-9 of the official test RMSE (never the best seed); uncertainty = paired/unpaired moving-block bootstrap (block 25) of the test residuals, NOT the seed spread (seeds are expected to collapse onto one optimum; the reference code's 0.04 seed spread comes from network initialisation and is not comparable)
claim_rule.beats_0221_entry: only if, for every one of our seeds, the 95% upper bound of the paired moving-block-bootstrap RMSE difference (ours minus the reference code's seed-42 trajectory, test[50:], block 25) is below 0 (ct/compare_ref.py)
claim_rule.beats_reference_code_in_general: reported as the fraction of the other 10 reference seeds beaten under the same paired rule
claim_rule.wording: best published result on Cascaded Tanks, official split, n_init=50 free-run simulation RMSE, self-evaluated, as of 2026-10-07 -- used ONLY if the first rule holds; otherwise 'matches/does not beat' with the numbers
claim_rule.post_hoc: any further scoring of the test record after this run (e.g. variants, ensembles, reverse split) is logged, labelled post-hoc, and excluded from the claim

test_record_looked_at_before_freeze: dataset summary statistics (min/max of y, first 8 samples, saturation count) were printed at load time and the third-party 0.221 code was run on the test record (11 seeds, all logged); the test minimum (2.16 V < estimation minimum 2.91 V) motivated an additional level-extrapolation validation on the ESTIMATION record. No model of ours was scored on the test record before this freeze.
